scope: Declared atomic result-cluster eligibility experiment on successful emitted words; no speaker-preference claim and no claim about discarded attempts or unrelated phonotactics.
execution: Candidate code, measurement bindings and protocol must be committed and source/dependency/node/environment sealed before and after every job. Independent tool preflight corruption cases required before candidate corpus audits. Timing runs wait until every thread-owned bulk job terminates. Retain initial failures; do not regenerate or retune from observed outcomes.
baselineUse: Reuse both fully sealed 200000-word composed-control archives without modifying them. Capture the same default/active policies, four profiles, five development seeds and 10000 words/stream for the frozen candidate.
primaryAcceptance: Every emitted replacement evaluation independently reconstructed from its configured rule, prior accepted root state, selected affix forms and ownership projection. No accepted result with a declared shared-classifier rejection.
Every rejected proposal preserves its target phone identity and sound, omits its written half and introduces no eligibility RNG draw.
All licensed cross-morpheme repetition retains physical phone identities; two same-root adjacent phones cannot share that license.
secondaryReports: New transformation-created same-root adjacent equality, with full /sk/→/ss/ witnesses and denominators; equality itself is not universally illegal.
All rule outcomes/reasons by policy/profile/affix/target; baseline unavailable diagnostics remain unavailable.
Configured boundary licensing and cluster limits/features; all successful emitted records public replay and independent cell/phone replay.
Full length/phone/trigram/stress/morphology/repair/diversity counters and paired output changes; bare-profile preservation separately authenticated.
gatePolicy: Run full untouched control and candidate gates; preserve all failures. Compile each frozen checkout for original diagnostics and bind output to successful compilation. No sample/seed/floor/timeout/heap/variance override. Original 2m trigram and 50k trace audits retained.

timing.order: Adjacent control then candidate in each pair; no simultaneous thread-owned capture/replay/fit/gate load.

publication: Publish one independently reviewable Q11b PR only after complete archives, public/independent verification, all gates and six timing pairs with failures retained. No default-promotion claim based only on this protocol or small fixtures.
